app.name: My Schedule Manager
app.description: Your week is a loop. Hold the line, or watch your armor fail.

status.label: Character status
status.doomClock: Time until midnight. Open the Doom Clock.

home.title: The Keep
home.streak: {count, plural, =0 {No streak yet} one {# day streak} other {# day streak}}
home.armorFailing: Your armor is failing. Regain your level, or lose your tier.

reckoning.title: The Reckoning
reckoning.flavor: The day is sealed. What you did, and what you didn't, is written.
reckoning.collapsed: Your Power lay at zero for three reckonings. You lost a level.
reckoning.demoted: Your armor gave way. You fell a tier.

battleLog.title: Battle Log
battleLog.empty: No battles yet. The log waits for your first deed.

doom.title: Doom Clock
doom.lastHour: {count, plural, one {# block remains.} other {# blocks remain.}} The Eclipse watches.
doom.remaining: {count, plural, one {# block open today} other {# blocks open today}}

focus.leftWarning: You left. The Eclipse noticed. No penalty, but it's counted.

blockForm.title: Title
blockForm.midnightHint: An end time earlier than the start runs past midnight and counts on the start date.

loop.title: The Loop
loop.flavor: No blocks are carved here. The stone waits.
loop.applyConfirm: Also change this block in the template? Future blocks you haven't logged or edited will change too.
loop.removeConfirm: Remove this block for this day only?
loop.focusBroken: {count, plural, one {Focus broken once} other {Focus broken # times}}

restDays.label: Rest Day and Shield
restDays.isRestDay: Rest Day. No XP, no loss, and your streak holds.
restDays.isShield: Shield raised. No XP, no loss, and your streak holds.
restDays.usage: Rest Days this week: {rest} of {restLimit}. Shields this month: {shields} of {shieldLimit}.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Each template is one version of your week. One is active at a time.
templates.blockCount: {count, plural, =0 {No blocks yet} one {# block} other {# blocks}}
templates.deleteConfirm: Delete the {name} template and its blocks? Blocks already on your schedule stay.
templates.name: Name
templates.switchHint: Blocks from this date on change, except any you've logged or edited.
templates.blockEditHint: Blocks from today on change, except any you've logged or edited.
templates.emptyDay: Nothing carved. This day is free.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.productiveHint: This category counts like a block: you can log it in the Loop, and it needs a start and end time on one date.
calendar.plainHint: A plain event, with no XP and no penalty.
calendar.empty: Nothing is written here. The days are yours.
calendar.loadFailed: The calendar could not be read. Try again in a moment.
calendar.hint: Tap an empty time to add an event. Tap a block to open that day in the Loop.

errors.invalid: That doesn't look right. Check the fields and try again.
errors.failed: The scribe failed. Nothing was saved. Try again.
errors.futureBlock: That hour has not come. You can log a block once its day arrives.
errors.notLoggable: A rest block can't be logged.
errors.restMustBeFuture: A Rest Day must be declared before its day starts. Use a Shield today.
errors.restLimit: You've used this week's Rest Day.
errors.shieldInPast: A Shield can't be raised for a past day.
errors.shieldLimit: You've used all of this month's Shields.
errors.dayAlreadyDeclared: This day is already a Rest Day or Shield.
errors.cannotUndo: This can't be taken back now.
errors.templateInUse: This template is active or scheduled, so it can't be deleted.
errors.effectiveInPast: A template can't take effect in the past.
errors.eventProductiveTimed: This category counts like a block, so it needs a start and end time on one date.
errors.eventEndBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
errors.eventLinked: This block comes from a calendar event. Edit it in the Calendar.
errors.notCancellable: A logged block can't be removed.
errors.dayClosed: That day has been closed. It can only be corrected from the Loop, within 24 hours.
errors.correctionExpired: The 24 hours for correcting this day have passed.
errors.correctionNeedsStatus: A closed day's block must be done, partial or skipped.

oracle.title: The Oracle
oracle.flavor: The Oracle sleeps. Do not wake it before its hour.

more.title: More
more.flavor: Other halls lie behind these doors. Most remain barred.

settings.title: Settings
settings.timezoneHelp: Every "today", and the midnight closeout, follows this timezone.
settings.savedPreview: Language changed. Preview mode has no database, so the timezone was not kept.
settings.invalid: That choice is not recognized. Nothing was changed.
settings.saveFailed: The scribe failed. Nothing was saved. Try again.

login.title: Enter the Keep
login.subtitle: Only one soul may pass this gate.
login.notConfigured: The gate is not built yet. Finish docs/SETUP.md to enable sign-in.
login.error: Sign-in failed. The gate did not open. Try again.

accessDenied.title: Access denied
accessDenied.body: This account may not enter. You have been signed out.

preview.banner: Preview mode: sign-in is off on this development server.

states.errorBody: This page failed to load. Your data is safe.
